label: Ubiquiti NanoBeam M5 19 dBi
description: airMAX M 5 GHz CPE/bridge with a 19 dBi integrated dish: one 10/100 Ethernet port, passive PoE, 5170-5875 MHz.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti quick start guide: networking interface (1) 10/100 Ethernet port; operating frequency worldwide 5170-5875 MHz; gain 19 dBi; power method passive PoE (pairs 4, 5+; 7, 8 return). This is the M5 19 dBi dish - the NBE-M5-16 in the catalogue is a different antenna gain on the same radio, so both stay.
